newsitem.title: USA: Ultrak sees Q2 EPS of $0.05 to $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Ultrak sees Q2 EPS of $0.05 to $0.08.

text.p: Ultrak Inc on Monday said it expected to report second-quarter earnings of between $0.05 and $0.08 a share, compared with $0.17 in the year-earlier period, when the company had fewer shares outstanding.
Second-quarter revenues are expected to range from $44 million and $46 million, compared with $31.8 million in the 1996 quarter.

It attributed the expected decline to a temporary slowdown in sales and price erosion in the market for closed-circuit television products. It also said the strength of the dollar, combined with lackluster economic coniditions in Europe, was hurting its operations there.
The company, which makes security alarms, said it would release its second-quarter results in the second half of July.
